why: phase-515 R10 stage 1b (2026-10-27): the executor's node-id-keyed parameter forms left the Rust user surface (behind the sealed `nros_node::executor::ffi::ExecutorFfi`, as R9 stage 1 did for the C-shaped entry points), so the node is the one user-facing parameter receiver, as rclrs's is. `Node::disable_parameter_events` forwards to `Executor::disable_parameter_events_on(node_id, ...)`; the store is still the executor's one table (phase-426 W1). Issue 2023: this node publishes no `/parameter_events` (rclc's `notify_changed_over_dds = false`; rclcpp's `start_parameter_event_publisher(false)`). rclrs has no counterpart. Test: `packages/core/nros-node/src/executor/tests.rs` (`the_node_carries_the_whole_parameter_surface`).
